label: Alexandro Wiggins
narrative: Alexandro C. Wiggins is a US Navy Senior Chief Petty Officer, an Operations Specialist with roughly twenty-three years of service, who testified in uniform and on active duty before the House Oversight Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets on 9 September 2025. That fact alone distinguishes him from almost every witness who preceded him: Fravor, Graves, Grusch and Elizondo all testified after leaving service. Wiggins's written statement places him aboard USS Jackson (LCS-6) on 15 February 2023 at approximately 1915 PST in the W-291 Warning Area off Southern California. He states he 'visually observed a light rising from the waterline, consistent with a platform emerging from the ocean rather than distant surface lights or celestial rise.' The object was self-luminous and Tic Tac-shaped; it joined three similar objects; the four held controlled geometry and departed simultaneously with near-instantaneous acceleration, producing no sonic boom, no exhaust plume and displaying no visible control surfaces - characteristics he described as inconsistent with conventional aircraft or drones. Combat Information Center personnel recorded the event on the ship's Star SAFIRE multi-spectral EO/IR system and reported to the Tactical Action Officer. The footage was subsequently published by journalists Jeremy Corbell and George Knapp. Wiggins is therefore a rare complete chain: a named, credentialed, serving witness; a specified date, time and operating area; a named sensor system; a documented internal report; and released imagery.
